hierarchy.name: Regulatory blocs
hierarchy.description: EU and EEA membership by country, dated (valid_from inclusive, valid_to exclusive). Seeded by migration 060; maintained here by compliance writers. Dates are the day each accession took effect (EEA: the day each enlargement agreement began to apply, provisionally where ratification came later). The UK left the EU and the EEA on 2020-01-31; EU law (and the EEA Agreement) still applied to it during the transition period to 2020-12-31, which is not a membership and is not recorded here. Only member states are listed: territories with their own ISO code (Åland, French outermost regions, Gibraltar until 2020) are not, and can be added as members.

sources: CVCE, Member States and EU applicant countries: chronology of accession agreements (https://www.cvce.eu/en/obj/member_states_and_eu_applicant_countries_chronology_of_ec_ue_association_and_accession_agreements-en-9c983946-ead0-4021-8098-5c4d7aa8242c.html)
EFTA, EEA legal texts: entry into force 1994-01-01; enlargement agreements applied from 2004-05-01, 2007-08-01 and 2014-04-12 (https://www.efta.int/about-efta/legal-documents/eea-legal-texts)
EEA Council Decision No 1/95: entry into force for Liechtenstein 1995-05-01 (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec/1995/1(3)/oj)
